name: Blue Professional
description: The restraint of a consulting report: warm cream paper, a single electric cobalt, ink-black headings and grey captions; Space Grotesk headings with Inter body text, CJK falling back to Noto Sans TC or Microsoft JhengHei. Cards are a pale blue tint with a 1.5px translucent border and 12px radius, no solid borders or shadows. Every page has a blue uppercase eyebrow top left, a pale blue rounded tag top right, the page number bottom left and a 3px progress bar along the bottom edge that advances with the page count; numbers are always cobalt, processes are numbered blue circles joined by faint lines, and the call to action is the only solid blue pill. Ported from beautiful-html-templates’ blue-professional.

ink.use: primary text; inverted pages use cobalt as the background

accent.use: the only accent: short rules, eyebrow, numbers, progress bar, charts, icons, process nodes, call to action

surface.use: card, table, tab and code block background (the original’s 4% cobalt tint, pre-blended with the paper)

line.use: card borders, table rules, rings, process connectors (the original’s 20% cobalt)

tint.use: cover diagonal panel, tag background, statement box background, chart track (the original’s 8% cobalt)

light.use: cover meta line, page number, context line of stat cells

display.family: 'Space Grotesk', 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', sans-serif

body.family: 'Inter', 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', sans-serif

vocabulary: numbered blue circles with faint connectors
statement box on a pale blue tint with a blue left rule
avoid: centred headings (cover and body pages; quote and closing are the exception)
